metadata.tags: Hyper-glossy kawaii bass and cinematic dubstep hybrid, male vocals. Intro builds with distant anime one-shots and filtered arps rising over a thick, detuned bass swell. Verses ride a tense half-time groove with glitchy stutters and bitcrushed fills, vocal very affected and close. Choruses slam into full-power four-on-the-floor meets riddim-style drops, stacked harmonies and vocoder doubles, bright leads cutting through the low-end growl. Bridge goes to an emotional, atmospheric break with chopped vocal phrases and distant choir, then snaps into a final, maximal drop and abrupt tail., cinematic dubstep, anime, electronic, electronicore, soaring, rapid

metadata.gpt_description_prompt: Thick, growling bass pulses under rapid-fire synths and sparkling kawaii bass leads, fusing with soaring, reverb-laden vocals processed for an otherworldly touch. Japanese anime-inspired samples and melodic motifs blend with heavy cinematic dubstep drops and glitchy, electronicore breakdowns; verses are tense, with digital effects swirling, choruses explode with layered aggression and vibrant electronic textures, lyrics reflecting escape and self-empowerment.
